name: Public domain (NOAA National Weather Service)
content: The information on National Weather Service (NWS) Web pages are in the public domain, unless specifically noted otherwise, and may be used without charge for any lawful purpose so long as you do not: 1) claim it is your own (e.g., by claiming copyright for NWS information -- see below), 2) use it in a manner that implies an endorsement or affiliation with NOAA/NWS, or 3) modify its content and then present it as official government material. The same terms apply to the alerts of api.weather.gov and to the tsunami messages of tsunami.gov (Pacific Tsunami Warning Center and National Tsunami Warning Center, both NWS). Full disclaimer: https://www.weather.gov/disclaimer
